about: Every 4000 / 4096 / 4095 in the engine and the builder's frame checks, classified against the coordinate range (CHIM-FRAME-COORD-RANGE-33, engine/aga/src/aw_coord.h): bound = follows the coordinate bound (AW_COORD_BOUND; tools/coord_range.py in the builder: wide by default since v0.0.36, narrow with --coord-range narrow); kept = about positions or distances but deliberately unchanged (why in note); unrelated = not a position. tests/test_coord_range_audit.py fails on any new occurrence that is not listed.
